[u][b]Seriously in Love ♥ Tsundere Secret Oppai Bunny!♥[/b][/u]
Race: Cow Demihuman
Second Year at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy

She was second-year student at Usaki Academy who ended up transported to another world along with the protagonist. She wasn’t officially part of any club, but she often hung around the app development club’s room. When she was transported to the other world, she was assigned the race setting of a “Cow Demihuman.”

Her personality is cheerful and energetic, a classic outgoing type with a bit of a wild streak. She’s a total otaku girl who loves anime, games, and manga. She also has a strong desire for approval, and when praised, she quickly gets flustered and turns into a dere-dere type.

While she usually speaks boldly and with a sharp tongue, she’s actually quite sweet and pure on the inside. She developed a secret crush on the protagonist after playing a game he had made in the past and being emotionally moved by it (She really, really wants her existence to be acknowledged and recognized.) At the same time, she also sees herself as a serious rival to him, thinking, “I won’t lose either!” They constantly bicker because she can’t be honest with her feelings. She also moonlights as a popular video streamer using a VTuber avatar, and her account, Booby Video Channel, boasts over 300,000 subscribers.

Her hobbies include anime and manga appreciation, and streaming game playthroughs. When it comes to being a bunnygirl, she gets flustered but tries to act tough, saying things like, “Do I really look good in this?” and “Aren’t you staring a little too much?”
